metadata.title: One-page primer: Field → Scene → Encounter → Medium

content:
One-page primer: Field → Scene → Encounter → Medium
A medium-agnostic blueprint for building narrative/world-based work, then translating it into any form.
Core reframing
Field = the persistent experiential world you offer (your “pool” of meaning).

Scene = a bounded extraction from that field (a specific instance with a turn, or a shaped traversal).

Narrator = the stable interface that controls access (lens) and address (how the work speaks).

Audience is not a profile. The only required “audience variable” is Encounter Mode: how the work is meant to be engaged.

Pipeline: Field → Scene → Encounter Mode → Medium encoding
Narrator spans Field/Scene as the stable interface across versions.

Minimal system v1 (3 modules)
1) Field Spec (persistent)
A field is defined by recurrence and exclusions. It preserves identity across an album/era/identity.
Fill:
thesis: core way-of-seeing the field offers

anchors: recurring symbols/motifs/objects/sounds/gestures

qualities: descriptive axes (tone/texture/attitude)

boundaries: hard exclusions (what it never becomes)

laws (optional): recurring cause/cost logic

field:
  thesis: ""
  anchors: ["", "", ""]
  qualities: ["", "", ""]
  boundaries: ["", ""]
  laws: [""]  # optional
2) Scene Extraction (instance)
A scene is a selection from the field plus a shaped change (or shaped traversal).
Fill:
extracted_from_field: which anchors are active

frame: where/when/scale within the field

turn: start → pivot → end (omit pivot/end if field-only traversal)

evidence_tokens: 3–7 must-show observables (cross-medium invariants)

scene:
  extracted_from_field: ["anchor_id_1", "anchor_id_2"]
  frame: ""
  turn: {start: "", pivot: "", end: ""}   # optional for field-only
  evidence_tokens: ["", "", ""]
3) Narrator Interface (lens + address)
Narrator is the designed interface that makes the field/scene encounterable.
Lens = where the perception sits + what it can access.
Address = who it speaks to + posture + disclosure.
narrator:
  lens:
    vantage: "inside|edge|outside|above"
    access: "surface-only|inner-only|mixed|omniscient"
    time_mode: "live|recalled|foretold|curated"
    reliability: "reliable|strategic|mistaken|unstable|unknown"
    selection_rule: "Notices X first; ignores Y."
    agency: "observer|participant|manipulator"
  address:
    addressee: "none|implicit witness|confidant|public|future self|unknown"
    posture: "invite|assert|confess|warn|inquire|document|invoke"
    disclosure: "withhold-heavy|balanced|reveal-heavy"

Encounter Mode (interaction contract)
This is where “audience dictates medium” belongs—without demographic profiling.
Pick one primary mode:
ambient (inhabit; low demanded attention)

guided (follow; you steer attention)

participatory (they act; choices matter)

ritual (repeat; meaning accrues through recurrence)

broadcast (receive; one-to-many address)

private (intimate channel)

encounter_mode:
  mode: "ambient|guided|participatory|ritual|broadcast|private"
  attention: "low|mid|high"
  revisit_value: "low|mid|high"
  onboarding: "implicit|explicit"
Downstream medium bias (examples)
ritual → loopable forms, recurrence, replay value (mixes, live sets, iterative visuals).

participatory → interactive systems, game-like structures, responsive installations.

guided → linear time-based forms (songs, films, narrative text).

ambient → installation, generative works, longform atmospheres.


Full “North Star” card (copy/paste)
field:
  thesis: ""
  anchors: ["", "", ""]
  qualities: ["", "", ""]
  boundaries: ["", ""]
  laws: [""]  # optional

scene:
  extracted_from_field: ["", ""]
  frame: ""
  turn: {start: "", pivot: "", end: ""}   # optional for field-only
  evidence_tokens: ["", "", ""]

narrator:
  lens:
    vantage: "inside|edge|outside|above"
    access: "surface-only|inner-only|mixed|omniscient"
    time_mode: "live|recalled|foretold|curated"
    reliability: "reliable|strategic|mistaken|unstable|unknown"
    selection_rule: "Notices X first; ignores Y."
    agency: "observer|participant|manipulator"
  address:
    addressee: "none|implicit witness|confidant|public|future self|unknown"
    posture: "invite|assert|confess|warn|inquire|document|invoke"
    disclosure: "withhold-heavy|balanced|reveal-heavy"

encounter_mode:
  mode: "ambient|guided|participatory|ritual|broadcast|private"
  attention: "low|mid|high"
  revisit_value: "low|mid|high"
  onboarding: "implicit|explicit"

Workflow (intended use)
Define Field once per era/album/identity.

For each output, extract a Scene (or field-only traversal).

Set Narrator lens/address to control access and communication.

Choose Encounter Mode to define engagement.

Translate into a medium using evidence tokens + turn + narrator + encounter as invariants.
